ai_content.desc_en: In "A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires", noblewoman Elizabeth, after being publicly betrayed by the crown prince and thrown into prison, escapes her kingdom with the legendary Seven Grimoires. With the help of a viscount from a neighboring nation, she rebuilds her life and plots her revenge against the kingdom that cast her aside. An animated series filled with sci-fi, fantasy, and adventure.
